_comment: Copy to settings.json (machine-local, gitignored) or just start X4Switch.exe: it creates settings.json itself when you pick a mode or change Settings. Every key is optional; an empty string means auto-detect / default.
_language: '' = the Windows UI language (Hungarian -> hu, anything else -> en), 'en' or 'hu'.
_lastMode: The choice selected when the window opens: 'cockpit' or 'single'. Remembered automatically.
_gameArgs: Arguments for X4.exe in both modes, e.g. -debug all -logfile debug.log. '' = none.
_rect: Cockpit window rectangle 'x,y,w,h' (e.g. -1920,0,7280,1440). '' = computed from the live monitor arrangement (recommended).
_companionDir: The X4 Companion (browser dashboard). '' = <this folder>\..\x4companion. Missing = single monitor without dashboard.
_dashboardPort: 0 = the port in the companion's state\watcher.json, else 8788.
_advanced: Normally unset (used by the tests): cockpitSettingsFile, monitorsJson, cockpitLogDir, companionStateDir, companionLogDir, companionMutex, powershellExe, launchWaitSeconds (30), dashboardWaitSeconds (30).
